Mighty Adventures Brand

Dinosaur themed crazy golf was always going to be a hit with the kids. But how could we turn this family day out into a brand that stands out in the category? We created a brand that families can sink their teeth into.

The work

Invention

A Mighty Adventure

We took brand storytelling to the next level with a series of children’s books. Creating relatable characters that spread messages of sharing, kindness and courage that delight boys, girls and families alike (with irresistible mischief and guaranteed LOL’s).

Then brought the characters to life on the golf course. An exciting story, relatable characters, educational messaging and a fun tone of voice for stand out in a competitive marketplace.
